text: FirstRand Bank Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary of FirstRand Limited, which is listed on the JSE and the Namibian Stock Exchange.
short: FirstRand Bank Limited is wholly owned by JSE-listed FirstRand Limited.

source.name: FirstRand Bank Limited Annual Report 2023 (PDF)
source.quote: FirstRand Bank Limited (FRB or the bank) is a wholly owned subsidiary of FirstRand Limited (FirstRand or the group), which is listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) and Namibian Stock Exchange (NSX).
